project_type: Vite + React 18 + TypeScript SPA with Tailwind CSS and Radix UI
build_system: Vite 5 — `npm run build` (tsc then vite build). Path alias `@/` maps to `src/`. Tailwind 3 with JIT.
test_framework: Vitest 3 + @testing-library/react 16 + jsdom. Config in vite.config or vitest.config. Run with `npm test` (vitest run).
verification_instructions: 1) Run `npx tsc --noEmit` — must exit 0 with no errors. 2) Run `npm test` — all suites must pass. 3) Run `npm run build` — must exit 0.
environment_constraints: Windows workspace. Do not start a dev server. All file edits should be within c:\Users\User\Desktop\event-frontend — never write outside this path.
contribution_requirements: Preserve all aria-labels and role/text strings that the test suite queries: role='tab' with names Users/Events/Audit Log/Reports; aria-label='Back to Users' button in AdminUserDetail; aria-label='Sign out'; aria-label='Toggle user view'. Do not rename or remove these.
key_patterns: All admin components use inline styles with `var(--adm-*)` CSS variables. CSS variables are defined in `src/index.css` inside `.adm {}` block. Components use Tailwind for layout classes and inline style for colors/dimensions. Hover states tracked with `useState<string|null>(null)` for row IDs or `useState<boolean>(false)` for single buttons. Admin API calls use `fetchAdminUserDetails(userId)` from `@/lib/adminApi` which returns `AdminUserDetailsFull`.
directory_structure: src/pages/ — page-level components (AdminPanelPage.tsx). src/components/admin/ — all admin sub-components. src/lib/ — API helpers (adminApi.ts, auth.ts, api.ts). src/__tests__/ — vitest test files mirroring src structure. src/index.css — global styles including .adm {} CSS variable block.
